<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Lok Sabha expansion:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved a bill to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50% and freeze delimitation until 2051, with plans for a Supreme Court judge to head the oversight panel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNbl9sOUV3RUdhaXpRSEQ0Xzdjc2NVemZWRGFYangwYUtxZnE5YzRsZWpDMF9kZi1CSVE3Qm5Kbi1KVVc2Vm91NDJoTkJGbmZGZjc3V09OUVdyMG5zaWJndmhpaHFjVkVHQndJZE55SDR4dGxlRFRHdXZwYU9RdWd4Q1hFaWdaaWxtdEdaQWhfbTJRamoyWWE4aw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition discord:</strong> Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders are mobilizing to oppose the Delimitation Bill, while internal tensions have surfaced as the Congress party criticizes the NCP (SP) for supporting the government&#x27;s move.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal clarification:</strong> The Supreme Court ruled that the manager of Durgah Khwaja Saheb School does not hold an &quot;office of profit,&quot; clarifying constitutional disqualification criteria under Article 102(1)(a).<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE5vY3R2Z09FV0xGV3dzMS05b0dqVnZRd1EwTnJiY2dkYTJkM0tZanpWUWxXLXp1bzJGQkFfNHRDbUNTc1pVQS1IMi1sRl84TTQ0bkNBTC1WOWFWc0lGUEhIaHRMSmdsdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>
